name: Crownhate Ruin
label: Dischord
lede: Two thirds of Hoover's front line, back on stage barely two months after Hoover died, playing something darker, twistier and a lot less friendly to the Hoover fans who came to see them.

eras.title: Hoover's ashes, still warm
eras.text: Hoover had lasted about two years and one Dischord album, The Lurid Traversal of Route 7, before splitting in 1994. Fred Erskine and Joe McRedmond didn't wait: Dischord dates Crownhate Ruin to May 1994.

years.p: Hoover, the D.C. band where three of four members shared vocals, breaks up in 1994, the year its only album, The Lurid Traversal of Route 7, comes out. Fred Erskine and Joe McRedmond keep going together.

years.h: Crownhate Ruin's first show, two months after Hoover ends
years.p: [[Fred Erskine|4e2f1c33-e9a9-4aff-9b90-d9b1d3e8af19]] on bass and vocals, [[Joe McRedmond|132df41f-6981-4db5-93cc-47aa88b825c9]] on guitar and vocals, [[Vin Novara|bfec86c6-f1ae-4915-ac83-c1806a929118]], ex-[[1.6 Band|e3b548df-c063-4603-bac1-1b01fcf84ef2]], on drums. Dischord says the first show came barely two months after Hoover's demise.
years.xp:
Dischord's history says Crownhate Ruin moved into a darker area than Hoover, with more challenging arrangements and time signatures. AllMusic describes slashing guitars and screamed vocals.

Fred Erskine was a trained musician: violin from age four, then piano, then trumpet at eight, per Wikipedia. He'd picked up bass only after joining a punk band as a singer in 1987.

years.big: Not the band you came to see
years.h: Some Hoover fans balk at Crownhate Ruin
years.p: Dischord says the reception from some Hoover followers was mixed at first. Crownhate Ruin won its own crowd the slow way, show by show and record by record.

eras.title: Singles, a split, the road
eras.text: Wikipedia says Crownhate Ruin began touring and recording right away. 1995 was a year of seven-inches, including a split with Boston's Karate.

years.p: Three singles: "Lesson in Thread" backed with "Pioneers"; "Present to President" and "Last Place in Triage" backed with "My Country Getaway"; then "Better Still If They Don't Know" with "Every Minute's Sucker."
Crownhate Ruin share a seven-inch with Boston's Karate on Art Monk Construction, the small D.C. label named for Redskins receiver Art Monk.

years.h: Live at the Ford Court House, Auburn AL, July 10, 1995
yt: Live at the Ford Court House, Auburn AL, July 10, 1995

eras.title: One album and out
eras.text: Crownhate Ruin finally made a full-length in 1996, with Geoff Turner at WGNS, and it was the only one. By December the band was over and Erskine was headed for Chicago.

years.p: Dischord lists Crownhate Ruin's Intermediate as an early-1996 release on a half-number in the catalog, a stopgap before the album Until the Eagle Grins.

Crownhate Ruin's only album, recorded at WGNS and produced by [[Geoff Turner|591fc466-2668-4524-852d-a6cc5f18cff7]]. Ten songs, including "Late Arriving Rock Dudes" and "Tornado Season Finale," plus both sides of the "Better Still If They Don't Know" single.

years.h: Crownhate Ruin ends; Fred Erskine leaves for Chicago
years.p: Dischord closes Crownhate Ruin's run in December 1996. Fred Erskine moves to Chicago and joins [[June of 44|56f3de75-2c88-4054-a1df-65c661f4ee0f]], per AllMusic.

eras.title: Everyone keeps playing together
eras.text: Fred Erskine, Joe McRedmond and Vin Novara kept turning up in each other's bands for years, Hoover came back in 1997 and 2004, and in 2022 Crownhate Ruin's early singles finally got collected on vinyl.

years.p: Hoover re-forms in 1997 to record a mini-album of odds and ends for Slowdime, and again in 2004 for US and European dates. The Crownhate Ruin musicians also work together later in Boom, HiM and [[The Sorts|fc0377f7-b7fc-4b17-9cef-3db0fa5c6d00]], per Wikipedia.

years.h: Crownhate Ruin on 20 Years of Dischord
years.p: Crownhate Ruin make Dischord's anniversary set, 20 Years of Dischord, Dischord No. 125.

BCore Disc and New Atlantis co-release Singles and Early Recordings: 1994–1995: ten tracks, including the singles and early songs like "Visit from Mars." The digital edition is dated December 20, 2022.
